text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Here is the birthday celebration 
bento that I promised you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You seemed interested in Japanese cuisine, 
Kris S-san, so I packed a whole bunch of 
Japanese home-cooked dishes!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First up, the classics: rolled omelets, 
octopus sausages, fried chicken, and 
simmered veggies.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned before that you weren't very 
used to plain white rice, right, Kris 
S-san? So I made seasoned mixed rice 
instead. And then—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I'm so sorry! Could it be that 
there's an ingredient you don't like—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I want to listen... while eating. About 
your... home-cooked food. Piece by 
piece... I want to understand... as I 
eat."
